h: A Navy Day Out With a Burst of Speed
p: Gosport makes a brilliant base for a full day out that mixes history with a bit of high-octane fun. Start with the museums, finish with the karts, or the other way around if the kids are too excited to wait.

Across the harbour, Portsmouth Historic Dockyard is home to HMS Victory, HMS Warrior and the Mary Rose Museum. The Spinnaker Tower at Gunwharf Quays gives you sweeping views of the Solent and the Isle of Wight on a clear day. Because the Gosport Ferry runs across in just a few minutes, you can take in both sides of the harbour in a single day without needing the car.

If you're doing the karting with a family group, check junior age and height limits before booking, and give everyone time to have something to eat beforehand, but not too much. A full stomach and tight corners don't mix.
Arrive in good time to get signed in, and remember the ferry runs to a timetable, so check it if you're hopping across from Portsmouth.

On the driving side, smooth is quick. Brake in a straight line before each bend, look ahead to where you want to go, and try to roll some speed through the corners rather than stopping and starting. Watch the lap times drop as you get the hang of it. Whoever tops the board can buy the ice creams on the front.
